cardObtain: [Unidentified] Defeat this monster in Hollow Zero 1 time to obtain its data
cardQuote: — A lecturer sharing their experience during Defense Force recruit training
cardSkillDesc: During combat, the Shielded Defender Omega becomes more aggressive and deploys a shield. While shielded, it is impossible to accumulate any Anomaly Buildup other than Electric. Applying the Shock effect or putting it into a Stunned state will immediately break the shield.
desc:
An automatic tactical mech of the Defense Force, providing continuous fire support for front-line personnel.
Its inert Ether shield can withstand most light firepower and even impacts from large-sized Ethereals.
Undoubtedly, it is one of the most trusted "companions" of the Defense Force.
"Remember, if you're in trouble, just stay behind them... You'll be pretty safe unless they accidentally squish you."
name: Shielded Defender Omega
